title: Elements of AI
description: A non-technical introduction to what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and how it affects society. Built for people with no programming or maths background.
what_you_learn: What AI and machine learning mean
who_for: Curious beginners and professionals who want AI literacy without coding.

title: CS50's Introduction to Artificial Intelligence with Python
description: Harvard's course on the ideas behind modern AI, taught with Python projects. It covers search, knowledge, uncertainty, optimization, learning, neural networks and language.
who_for: Learners who know basic Python and want a rigorous but friendly AI foundation.

title: Google AI Essentials
description: A short beginner course on using generative AI tools at work. It focuses on practical tasks, prompting and responsible use rather than building models.
what_you_learn: Using AI for everyday work tasks
who_for: Office workers and job seekers who want to use AI tools productively.

title: AI For Everyone
description: Andrew Ng's non-technical course on AI terminology, project workflow and strategy. It helps managers and non-engineers talk sensibly about AI projects.
what_you_learn: What makes an AI project feasible

title: Generative AI for Everyone
description: Andrew Ng's introduction to how generative AI works and how to apply it at work and in projects. It combines concepts with hands-on prompting examples.
who_for: Anyone wanting a clear, non-coding overview of generative AI.

title: AI for Beginners
description: An open-source 12-week curriculum with lessons, quizzes and notebooks covering symbolic AI, neural networks, computer vision and NLP. Runs in Colab or locally.
what_you_learn: Neural networks with PyTorch and TensorFlow

title: Machine Learning for Beginners
description: A classic-ML curriculum built around world cultures as datasets, using Scikit-learn. Each lesson has pre- and post-quizzes and assignments.
who_for: Beginners who want classical ML before deep learning.

title: Generative AI for Beginners
description: A lesson series that teaches how to build generative AI applications. Lessons include concept videos and Python and TypeScript code samples.
what_you_learn: Working with RAG and vector databases

title: AI Agents for Beginners
description: A lesson-by-lesson course on designing and building AI agents. It covers agentic design patterns, tool use, RAG and multi-agent setups with code.

title: Data Science for Beginners
description: A 10-week, 20-lesson curriculum on data science foundations with quizzes and notebooks. It walks from data ethics to visualization and the data science lifecycle.
who_for: Beginners starting a data science path.

title: Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) learning path
description: Microsoft's entry-level certification page, linking to free self-paced Learn modules on AI workloads and Azure AI services. A paid exam is optional.
who_for: Beginners wanting a cloud-flavoured AI foundation.

title: Machine Learning Crash Course
description: Google's self-study ML course with explanations, interactive exercises and videos. It covers core concepts through to neural networks and data handling.
who_for: Learners with basic programming and algebra.

title: Google Cloud ML and AI training
description: Google Cloud's catalog of courses, labs and learning paths on ML and generative AI. Some content is free; hands-on labs may need credits.
who_for: Cloud and data practitioners who want to use Google's AI stack.

title: Machine Learning Specialization
description: Andrew Ng's updated beginner-friendly ML sequence using Python. It covers supervised and unsupervised learning, neural networks and recommenders.
who_for: Aspiring ML practitioners with basic Python.

title: Deep Learning Specialization
description: A five-course sequence on neural networks, CNNs, sequence models and structuring ML projects. Taught by Andrew Ng with programming assignments.
who_for: Learners who know basic ML and Python.

title: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
description: A library of short, hands-on courses built with industry partners on LLMs, RAG, agents and more. Each is video plus runnable notebooks.

title: ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers
description: A short course with Isa Fulford and Andrew Ng on prompting LLMs through an API. It demonstrates summarizing, inferring, transforming and expanding text.
who_for: Python-literate developers new to LLM prompting.

title: Generative AI with Large Language Models
description: A course on the LLM lifecycle: transformers, pre-training, fine-tuning and deployment. It includes labs and discusses scaling and alignment.

title: Prompt Engineering for ChatGPT
description: A Coursera course on prompt patterns for large language models, taught by Jules White. It treats prompts as reusable patterns for varied tasks.
who_for: Beginners and professionals using ChatGPT-style tools.

title: Learn Prompting
description: A long-running prompt engineering guide and course platform for generative AI. It has free guides and structured material from basics to advanced techniques.
who_for: Anyone learning to prompt LLMs well.

title: Prompt Engineering Guide
description: An open guide collecting prompting techniques, research papers and tool notes. It covers zero-shot, few-shot, CoT, RAG and agents.
who_for: Developers and researchers wanting a reference.

title: OpenAI Academy
description: OpenAI's learning hub with videos, guides and community resources about using ChatGPT and OpenAI tools. Content ranges from basics to workplace and developer topics.

title: OpenAI Prompt Engineering Guide
description: OpenAI's official documentation on writing better prompts for its models. It lists strategies and tactics with examples.

title: OpenAI Cookbook
description: A collection of example code and guides for tasks with the OpenAI API. It spans embeddings, function calling, RAG and evaluation.

title: Anthropic Courses
description: Anthropic's GitHub repository of educational courses, including API fundamentals, prompt engineering and tool use. Delivered as Jupyter notebooks.
who_for: Developers who want hands-on Claude skills.

title: Prompt Engineering Interactive Tutorial
description: A step-by-step interactive tutorial with exercises on prompting Claude. It moves from basic structure to advanced techniques.

title: Anthropic Academy
description: Anthropic's course platform with training on Claude, the API and related tools. Course lineup changes over time.
who_for: Users and developers working with Claude.

title: Anthropic Cookbook
description: Code examples and guides for building with Claude. Topics include tool use, RAG, classification and multimodal tasks.
who_for: Developers building on the Claude API.

title: Hugging Face LLM Course
description: A free course on using the Hugging Face ecosystem for transformers and LLMs. It covers Transformers, Datasets, Tokenizers and fine-tuning.
who_for: Python developers moving into NLP and LLMs.

title: Hugging Face AI Agents Course
description: A course on building AI agents, from fundamentals to frameworks like smolagents, LangGraph and LlamaIndex.

title: Hugging Face MCP Course
description: A course on the Model Context Protocol and building MCP servers and clients. Includes hands-on units.

title: Hugging Face Deep Reinforcement Learning Course
description: A hands-on course on deep reinforcement learning with libraries such as Stable Baselines3 and CleanRL. Students train agents in game environments.
who_for: Learners with Python and basic deep learning.

title: Hugging Face Audio Course
description: A course on applying transformers to audio tasks like speech recognition and generation.

title: Hugging Face Diffusion Models Course
description: A course on how diffusion models work and how to use and train them with the Diffusers library.
who_for: Learners curious about image generation internals.

title: Hugging Face Open-Source AI Cookbook
description: A collection of notebooks applying open-source models to practical problems. Topics include RAG, fine-tuning and evaluation.

title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
description: Jeremy Howard's top-down deep learning course. You train models early and learn the theory as you go.
who_for: Coders who want to get models working fast.

title: Kaggle Learn
description: Short, hands-on micro-courses with in-browser notebooks. Topics include Python, pandas, SQL, ML and intro to deep learning.

title: Intro to AI Ethics (Kaggle)
description: A short Kaggle course on bias, fairness and transparency in AI systems, with practical notebook exercises.

title: Practical Data Ethics
description: A free course on ethical issues in data science and AI, with case studies. It covers disinformation, bias, privacy and accountability.

title: Google Responsible AI Practices
description: Google's published recommended practices for building AI responsibly. Covers fairness, interpretability, privacy and safety.

title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
